experiment: #13 real model outputs vs schema-valid NaiveKeywordBaseline, 40 contexts x 4 models x 2 order
interpretation_zh: #13 Gemini naive baseline sanity check: schema-valid 的 NaiveKeywordBaseline 只是关键词/模板拼接，用于验证当前 Gemini judge + Lit2Test harness 是否会被字段齐全但内容浅的答案糊弄。若真实模型在正反序 folded 口径下稳定获胜，说明 judge 不是只看 schema/关键词。
